title: chat-server: owner id is accountId, drop "self"
description: Draft: the owner's local id is the JMAP accountId everywhere a client-facing field means the owner (senderId, reaction keys, deliveryReceipts condition, members, Mention.id, self-leave, hasMention, Space self-removal/self-nick, SpaceBan own records). The literal "self" is removed. No ChatContact may have the accountId as id. Update chat-server, chat-client, testjig.
